title: Forward Deployment Engineer
description:
Platform FDE
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



 About GreyLabs AI
 



 GreyLabs AI is building an enterprise\-grade Voice AI platform for the BFSI ecosystem. Our technology enables banks, insurers, NBFCs and financial\-services organizations to automate and humanize customer conversations across collections, sales, customer service and compliance.
 



 We are looking for a highly execution\-oriented Program Manager who understands how Generative AI applications are built and can translate real business requirements into effective AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
 



 About the Role
 



 This is not a traditional project\-coordination role. You will work hands\-on with prompts, conversation flows, agent logic, integrations and testing while owning the execution of client\-facing AI programs.
 



 You will take use cases from requirement discovery and solution design through prototyping, implementation, testing and production rollout. The ideal candidate is curious about how AI systems behave, enjoys experimenting with prompts and is comfortable solving problems in a fast\-moving startup environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 AI Agent and Prompt Development
 


* Design, write and optimize prompts for AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
* Convert business requirements into structured conversational flows, agent instructions, decision logic and guardrails.
* Build and configure AI agents capable of performing tasks, using tools, calling APIs and managing multi\-step conversations.
* Develop prompt frameworks covering personas, objectives, context, constraints, fallback handling and escalation logic.
* Test prompts across multiple scenarios, edge cases, customer personas, languages and conversation paths.
* Analyse agent failures, hallucinations and inconsistent responses, and continuously improve performance.
* Create evaluation frameworks and test datasets to measure accuracy, task completion, compliance and conversation quality.



 Program Execution
 


* Own AI implementation programs from discovery and POC to deployment and production go\-live.
* Create execution plans, define milestones and manage dependencies across clients, product, engineering and operations teams.
* Conduct client discussions to understand business processes and recommend suitable AI\-led workflows.
* Translate client requirements into clear product configurations, user stories and implementation documents.
* Coordinate API integrations, data requirements, UAT, issue resolution and production readiness.
* Track deliverables closely and proactively address delays, blockers and execution risks.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.
* Take ownership of issues until they are completely resolved.



 Voice AI and Conversational Experience
 


* Design natural and outcome\-oriented conversations for voice and chat channels.
* Configure conversation flows for use cases such as customer service, sales, collections, lead qualification and customer onboarding.
* Work with concepts such as intent recognition, entity extraction, context retention, interruption handling, fallback responses and human\-agent handoffs.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations involving LLMs, APIs, ASR, TTS, telephony and enterprise systems.
* Review conversation transcripts and performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.



 Must\-Have Requirements
 


* 1–3 years of experience in AI implementation, program management, product operations, solutions, conversational AI or a related role.
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and Generative AI tools.
* Demonstrable experience building or configuring at least one AI agent, voice agent, chatbot or LLM\-powered workflow.
* Understanding of LLM concepts such as system prompts, few\-shot prompting, structured outputs, tool or function calling, context management and hallucination control.
* Ability to independently test, troubleshoot and improve AI\-generated responses.
* Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, webhooks and system integrations.
* Strong execution discipline with the ability to drive projects from idea to production.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work from our Mumbai office.



 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 


* Experience with agent\-building or workflow platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Voiceflow, Dialogflow, Retell AI, Vapi or similar tools.
* Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or open\-source LLM APIs.
* Exposure to RAG, vector databases, knowledge bases and multi\-agent workflows.
* Experience with voice technologies, including speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech or telephony integrations.
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, BFSI, fintech or customer\-service automation.
* Basic proficiency in Python, SQL or low\-code automation platforms.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients.



 What Success Looks Like
 



 Within the first few months, you should be able to:
 


* Independently convert a business use case into a working AI\-agent workflow.
* Create prompts, conversation logic, guardrails and comprehensive test scenarios.
* Manage a client implementation from requirements gathering to go\-live.
* Identify agent\-performance issues and improve outcomes through structured experimentation.
* Deliver multiple AI programs with speed, ownership and attention to detail.



 Who Will Thrive in This Role
 



 You will be a strong fit if you:
 


* Prefer building and executing over only creating plans and trackers.
* Experiment with AI tools beyond your formal responsibilities.
* Are comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving technology.
* Combine structured program management with hands\-on problem\-solving.
* Take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Are excited by the opportunity to build production\-grade AI agents for large enterprises.

title: AML-AI / ML Platform Engineer
description:
**About Business Line/Function**
 The AML IT function sits within the BNP Paribas Corporate \& Institutional Banking (CIB) CEFS‑technology ecosystem and provides end‑to‑end technology platform that enables the bank’s anti‑money‑laundering (AML) program. Its core purpose is to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into robust, scalable, and secure IT solutions that detect, investigate, and report suspicious activity across the Group’s global operations.
   

  

 The AML IT business line is the technology backbone that transforms raw transaction data into actionable AML intelligence, ensuring that BNP Paribas CIB meets its regulatory obligations while maintaining operational resilience and innovation.
   

  

 Position Purpose
   

  

 The role centers on creating next‑generation AML capabilities and will be instrumental in protecting the BNPP Group from fraud, money‑laundering, and other financial crimes by using advanced technologies and innovative solutions.
   

  

 As an AI\-ML Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for turning advanced machine‑learning research into production‑grade solutions that detect fraud, money‑laundering and other financial‑crime typologies across the entire transaction‑monitoring value chain. This position is vital for shaping the core detection capability of the platform. You would be the technical cornerstone linking graph analytics, LLM‑driven reasoning, ML model outputs, reliable backend services and cloud‑native infrastructure to deliver a unified next‑generation AML detection platform.
   

  

 While direct AML experience is not mandatory, a strong foundation in machine learning, sound engineering practices, and a willingness to learn the financial\-crime domain are essential. Familiarity with regulated environments, model governance, or fraud and anomaly detection is an advantage, but we are primarily looking for engineers who can build robust, well\-calibrated, production\-grade models and reason carefully about their real\-world impact. The role will operate within a globally distributed environment.
   

  

 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Build and maintain a large‑scale knowledge graph (entities, transactions, ownership, sanctions, registries). Design ETL pipelines, entity‑resolution logic, and network‑level feature jobs for GNN models that score shell companies, detect circular flows, assess sanctions proximity and community risk.
* Create end‑to‑end pipelines that convert regulatory/investigative text into vector embeddings, store them in a vector DB, and orchestrate LLM‑based narrative generation, multi‑agent reasoning, and on‑demand query answering. Manage LLM gateways, prompt engineering, cost tracking and fallback handling for uncertain alerts.
* Own the non‑ML micro‑services that make ML outputs actionable (Alert Service, Case Manager, API Gateway, tuning matrix, deduplication, Signal Aggregator, rule‑engine integration, feature‑factory APIs, model registry). Ensure high‑throughput, low‑latency, event‑driven processing with Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and Docker deployments.
* Apply rigorous software‑engineering practices (CI/CD, MLflow, automated testing, monitoring, model governance, audit logging) to keep models robust, calibrated, explainable and compliant.
* Manage the on‑prem Kubernetes ecosystem (multi‑namespace clusters, Helm, ArgoCD GitOps, resource quotas, GPU scheduling) and the full data‑processing stack: Apache Spark/PySpark (batch \& streaming), Flink/Kafka Streams, dbt incremental models, Terraform/Pulumi IaC, and observability (Prometheus‑Grafana, ELK). Handle node provisioning, container images (Docker, ECR/Harbor) and end‑to‑end logging/monitoring/alerting.
* Collaborate with distributed data‑science, compliance, investigation and platform teams to translate domain expertise into scalable, production‑ready AML solutions that continuously improve BNPP’s risk‑management posture.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
- Advanced Machine‑Learning Engineering: Design, train, and ship production‑grade models (GNNs, LLMs, RAG pipelines) that are well‑calibrated, explainable and meet strict AML governance requirements. Demonstrates a deep understanding of model lifecycle management, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.

 Graph‑Data Mastery: Expertise in knowledge‑graph modelling (Neo4j/Cypher or similar), graph‑ETL at scale, and graph‑neural‑network frameworks (PyG, DGL). Able to engineer high‑throughput network‑feature pipelines, optimize sub‑graph extraction (\< 200 ms), and apply graph algorithms for risk scoring.
 - LLM \& Retrieval‑Augmented‑Generation Proficiency: Hands‑on experience with LangChain/LangGraph, prompt engineering, multi‑agent design, and vector‑database ecosystems (Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate). Capable of building robust RAG architectures, chunking, embedding, retrieval, re‑ranking and integrating LLM gateways with cost‑control and fallback mechanisms.

- Backend \& Integration Engineering: Solid track record building high‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry), and rule‑engine integrations (Drools or custom Python). Skilled at designing state‑machines, de‑duplication engines, and API‑gateway (Kong) configurations that expose ML outputs to downstream investigators.

- Cloud‑Native \& Data‑Platform Ops: Deep familiarity with on‑prem Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, ArgoCD GitOps), CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), and observability stacks (Prometheus‑Grafana, ELK/Loki). Proficient in Spark/Delta Lake, Flink/Kafka Streams, Terraform/Pulumi, and Docker containerization, including GPU node provisioning and sandbox quota management.

- Data‑Engineering Fundamentals \& Governance: Adept at handling noisy, large‑volume data: incremental ETL, schema evolution, ACID compliance, and feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis). Champions data‑quality, lineage, auditability, and regulatory compliance throughout the pipeline.

- Collaboration \& Communication Excels in globally distributed, cross‑functional teams; translates complex ML concepts into actionable requirements for compliance officers, investigators, and business stakeholders. Communicates clearly in written and oral forms, writes comprehensive documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger, design specs), and mentors junior engineers.

- Problem‑Solving Mindset \& Adaptability Approaches ambiguous AML typologies with curiosity and a systematic, data‑driven methodology. Quickly learns new financial‑crime domains, navigates regulated environments, and iterates on solutions under tight timelines while maintaining high quality and security standards.

**Nice To Have Skills**
* Experience with TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune, or JanusGraph for large‑scale network analytics.
* Familiarity with vLLM, LoRA/QLoRA fine‑tuning, and serving models on GPU clusters behind the firewall.
* Expertise building multi‑agent systems, tool‑calling patterns, and custom “Chain‑of‑Thought” prompt libraries.
* Deep knowledge of AML‑related standards (FATF, FinCEN, BSA, GDPR), SAR filing formats, and experience automating compliance documentation.


**Education Level**
 Bachelor Degree or equivalent
   

  

 Experience Level
   

  

 At least 7 years
   

  

**Job Title**
 AIML\_Engineer
   

  

**Date**
 18/05/2026
   

  

**Department**
 CEP IT
   

  

 Location:
   

  

 Mumbai
   

  

 Business Line
   

  

 Anti Money Laundering
   

  

**Reports To**
 AML\-IT Manager
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
   

  

 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind, and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Title:** 
 Senior Full Stack Developer – Java / Spring Boot / TypeScript
 



**Location:** 
 Airoli, Mumbai
 



**Employment Type:** 
 1 year contract (extendable based on performance)
 



**Work\-type:** 
 Hybrid (3 days WFO, 2 days WFH)
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-9 Years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer with 8\+ years of professional software development experience to design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high\-performance web applications.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot for backend development, along with hands\-on experience in TypeScript, HTML5, and Tailwind CSS for frontend development.
 



 The role involves developing REST APIs and microservices, building responsive web interfaces, implementing authentication and authorization using Keycloak, and working extensively with PostgreSQL.
 



 You will collaborate with product managers, architects, designers, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver production\-ready solutions in an Agile environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Backend Development** 



* Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop secure RESTful APIs and microservices.
* Apply Java 8\+, Spring Boot, Spring Security, and related Spring technologies.
* Implement business logic using clean code, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
* Design solutions with scalability, performance, fault tolerance, and maintainability in mind.
* Troubleshoot and optimize backend services and production issues.



**Frontend Development** 



* Develop responsive web interfaces using TypeScript, HTML5, and Tailwind CSS.
* Build reusable and maintainable frontend components.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs.
* Implement client\-side validation, error handling, state management, and performance optimization.
* Experience with React.js or a similar modern frontend framework is preferred.



**Database Development** 



* Design and maintain relational database schemas using PostgreSQL.
* Write complex and optimized SQL queries and database operations.
* Analyze query performance and implement indexing and optimization strategies.
* Ensure data integrity, consistency, and efficient database access.



**Authentication \& Security** 



* Implement authentication and authorization using Keycloak.
* Work with OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Secure REST APIs and frontend applications.
* Follow security best practices across the application stack.



**Architecture \& System Design** 



* Participate in high\-level and low\-level system design discussions.
* Design scalable, highly available, and fault\-tolerant applications.
* Contribute to architectural decisions involving microservices, APIs, databases, authentication, and frontend architecture.
* Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate solutions.



**DevOps \& Collaboration** 



* Work with Docker for application containerization.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Use Git/GitHub/GitLab and standard branching and pull\-request workflows.
* Participate in code reviews and provide technical guidance to other developers.
* Work effectively within Agile/Scrum teams.



  





**Key Requirements** 



* 7\-9 years of professional software development experience with strong Full Stack exposure.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Java 8\+ and Spring Boot.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
* Good knowledge of HTML5 and Tailwind CSS.
* Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL and advanced SQL.
* Strong understanding of Keycloak, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, and RBAC.
* Experience with Spring Security and securing REST APIs.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks, preferably React.js.
* Strong understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean architecture.
* Experience with Docker and containerized environments.
* Proficiency with Git and code\-review/pull\-request workflows.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to independently own technical tasks and contribute to architectural decisions.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Kubernetes and container orchestration
* CI/CD tools and pipelines
* Kafka or other messaging systems
* Redis or other caching technologies
* AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms
* Swagger/OpenAPI and Postman
* Automated testing using JUnit, Mockito, Jest, or similar frameworks
* Experience working with large\-scale enterprise applications



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 We are looking for a developer who can operate beyond simply implementing assigned tasks — someone who can understand business requirements, make sound technical decisions, contribute to system architecture, and take ownership of features from development through production deployment.
 



  





**The candidate should be comfortable working across the stack while having strong depth in Java/Spring Boot backend development.**

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full\-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter.
   

  

 Trusted by
 **leading brands** 
 across three continents, including
 **Gymshark** 
 ,
 **Huel and Oh Polly,** 
 Fospha
 **manages $4 billion** 
 in annual ad spend.
   

  

 We're scaling fast across
 **London, Mumbai, and Austin** 
 – and we're now looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Team!
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll build the products our customers rely on every day to make multi\-million dollar media decisions. You'll work across the full stack \- from crafting responsive, intuitive frontend experiences through to designing and scaling the backend microservices that power them \- and, given the seniority of this role, you'll also help shape system design and infrastructure decisions as we scale.
   

  

 You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and AI agents as part of our AI\-first operating model, where lean, high\-autonomy teams ship fast and learn faster. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who's comfortable owning a feature end\-to\-end \- from initial design through to production \- and who wants to grow their craft in a fast\-moving, ambitious environment.
   

  

 Where you'll focus
   

  

* Frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks (React.js or Next.js)
* Backend development using Python\-based microservices
* System design and infrastructure, contributing to architectural decisions as we scale
* End\-to\-end feature ownership across the stack
* (Nice\-to\-have) Exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering workflows


**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain full stack features \- from frontend UI/UX through to backend services and APIs in Python.
* Contribute to system design and infrastructure decisions, helping evolve our technical foundations as we scale.
* Get involved across the full Software Development Lifecycle, from initial planning and design through execution, release, and monitoring in production.
* Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code, and champion good engineering practices across the team.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into working software.
* Build and consume APIs (REST/GraphQL) that connect frontend experiences to backend services.
* Work with AI agents as part of our AI\-first operating model, using clear specifications to shape high\- quality, AI\-assisted engineering work.
* Take ownership of the quality, performance, and reliability of the features you ship.
* Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving candid, constructive feedback.
* Stay curious about new tools and technologies, including opportunities to explore Data Science / Data Engineering problems as they arise.


**What are we looking for?**
* Have around 5\+ years of professional experience as a full stack / senior software engineer, with a balanced skill set across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
* Have strong, hands\-on experience with front\-end technologies such as React.js or Next.js, and solid backend experience building and maintaining Python\-based microservices.
* Are comfortable contributing to system design and infrastructure decisions, reflecting the seniority of this role.
* Are comfortable working across the full stack and can move fluidly between frontend, backend, and infrastructure concerns.
* Have solid experience working in an agile environment and know how to embed quality into fast\-moving teams.
* Bring exceptional attention to detail and a genuine ownership mindset over what you build.
* Are enthusiastic about new technologies, with the ability to adapt and learn quickly \- we're open to candidates with strong experience in other modern languages/frameworks if the core skill set and seniority are a strong match.
* Have an awareness of spec\-driven AI development and how clear specifications shape the quality of AI\- assisted engineering work.
* Have the confidence and initiative to evolve ideas and pull pieces of work together into meaningful change.
* Have an active interest in self\-learning and growing your craft.
* Nice\-to\-have: exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering (not core to the role, but a strong plus).


 You don't have to tick every box. If you're a strong engineer who's hungry to step up, we'd still like to hear
   

  

 from you.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* Be part of a leading global venture builder, Blenheim Chalcot, and learn from the incredible talent in BC.
* Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities
* Flexible Benefits including Private Medical Subsidiaries, Life Assurance, Pension scheme etc
* 25 days of paid holiday \+ your birthday off!
* Quarterly team socials


**Our Values and Principles \-** 
 You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:
   

  

* Seek inclusion \& diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
* Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
* Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
* Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
* Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude


 Above all, our people show a willingness to work together and get their hands dirty to deliver product success, which means our customers are successful!

title: Security Researcher
description:
**About Job:** 




 We are looking for a security researcher with strong software engineering skills to help build an AI product for vulnerability discovery and validation. You will turn offensive security knowledge into agent capabilities, tools, and backend workflows that investigate customer and open source systems reliably.
 



  





**What you will build:** 



* Build backend components for agent execution, tool calling, model integration, and structured findings.
* Translate vulnerability research into agent workflows, reusable tools, and source code analysis capabilities.
* Implement controlled tool execution, sandbox isolation, scoped permissions, resource limits, and cleanup.
* Build persistent run state, retries, cancellation, crash recovery, and event streaming.
* Integrate security tools, independent verification, and evidence capture so findings are reproducible.
* Create realistic security scenarios, PoC\-based checks, and regression tests to improve detection quality and reduce false positives.



  





**Engineering experience:** 



* 3\+ years in software engineering, security engineering, or security research, with a track record of building software or security tools.
* Strong TypeScript/Node.js skills and Python experience for tooling, automation, and integrations.
* Experience with APIs, asynchronous systems, databases, automated testing, and debugging complex failures.
* Comfort with Linux, Docker, process/network behavior, and LLM tool calling; clear communication and ownership of components through delivery.



  





**Security knowledge** 



* Bring broad awareness across these layers, with hands\-on depth in at least two areas. Web/API or source code security should be one of your strongest areas.
* Web and APIs: injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR/BOLA, authorization, tenant isolation, and business\-logic abuse.
* Source code and dependencies: insecure deserialization, memory safety fundamentals, vulnerable libraries, malicious packages, and CVE reproduction.
* AI and LLMs: prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe tool use, and MCP trust boundaries.
* Identity and infrastructure: network security, Active Directory, cloud IAM, federation, and privilege escalation.
* Runtime and systems: container, sandbox, and VM isolation; operating\-system permissions, service/library flaws, and kernel attack surfaces.
* Deep kernel research, exploit development, fuzzing, or agent\-framework experience is a plus.



  





**Show us what you have built** 




 Share backend or agent systems, security tools, or open source contributions you have built. Explain what you owned, the security reasoning, design choices, and reliability challenges. CVEs, bug bounties, and research write\-ups provide additional context. A high\-level description is welcome for confidential work.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Avensys is a reputed global IT professional services company headquartered in Singapore. Our service spectrum includes enterprise solution consulting, business intelligence, business process automation and managed services. Given our decade of success, we have evolved to become one of the top trusted providers in Singapore and service a client base across banking and financial services, insurance, information technology, healthcare, retail and supply chain
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 We are looking for an Mumbai Based experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to design and develop a secure, scalable enterprise application using React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft 365 integrations. The candidate should be capable of independently owning modules from technical design through development, integration, troubleshooting, and deployment support.
 



  





 The candidate should be able to independently own a complete solution from technical design and database design through frontend/backend development, integration, unit testing, code review, SonarQube compliance, deployment support, and production troubleshooting.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Design and develop enterprise web applications using React JS.
 



 Develop scalable backend services and REST APIs using Node.js / TypeScript.
 



 Design and implement relational data models using PostgreSQL.
 



 Build configurable application modules, workflows, validation services, notifications, and administrative functions.
 



 Integrate with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and Azure services.
 



 Integrate with Azure OpenAI GPT for document\-processing and structured\-data extraction use cases.
 



 Develop secure internal and external REST APIs and enterprise integration services.
 



 Implement RBAC, authentication, authorization, business audit trails, structured logging, correlation IDs, retries, monitoring, and security controls.
 



 Develop scheduler/background\-processing services and asynchronous application workflows.
 



 Integrate with enterprise systems and middleware using APIs, files, queues, and controlled integration patterns.
 



 Perform code reviews and maintain code quality using Git and SonarQube.
 



 Support controlled manual DEV/UAT/Production deployments and database migration activities.
 



 Troubleshoot application/integration issues and perform root\-cause analysis.
 



 Work closely with architects, business analysts, infrastructure teams, integration teams, and other stakeholders.
 



  





 Must\-Have Skills
 



 6\+ years of software development experience with strong full\-stack development exposure.
 



 Strong hands\-on experience with React JS and Node.js.
 



 Strong JavaScript / TypeScript knowledge and RESTful API development experience.
 



 Strong experience with PostgreSQL or other enterprise relational databases.
 



 Good understanding of database design, transactions, indexing, query optimization, and data integrity.
 



 Experience implementing enterprise authentication, authorization, and RBAC.
 



 Experience with asynchronous processing, schedulers, retries, idempotency, and exception handling.
 



 Strong experience with Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
 



 Experience with application logging, audit trails, secure coding, and production troubleshooting.
 



  





 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 



 Microsoft Azure application development; Entra ID / OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC.
 



 Microsoft Graph API / Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and Teams / Adaptive Cards integration.
 



 Azure OpenAI / GPT API integration and Azure Blob Storage.
 



 Enterprise system / middleware integration and SAP integration exposure.
 



 Microsoft Power Automate Desktop / RPA exposure.
 



 SonarQube, Azure Application Insights / Log Analytics, and secure code\-quality practices.
 



 Experience with configurable workflow or rule\-engine\-based enterprise applications.
 



  





 WHAT’S ON OFFER
 



 You will be remunerated with an excellent base salary and entitled to attractive company benefits. Additionally, you will get the opportunity to enjoy a fun and collaborative work environment, alongside a strong career progression.
 



  





 To submit your application, please apply online or email your UPDATED CV to Sandeep.kumar@aven\-sys.com or WhatsApp at \+65 6761 9819
 



  





 Your interest will be treated with strict confidentiality.
 



  





 CONSULTANT DETAILS:

 Avensys Consulting Pte Ltd

title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Process Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 We are looking for a talented
 **Forward Deployed AI Engineer** 
 with a passion for software engineering, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and enterprise AI transformation. In this client\-facing role, you will work directly with customers to design, build, deploy, and scale production\-grade AI solutions that solve complex business challenges.
   

  

 You will act as the bridge between business and technology, partnering with stakeholders to transform organizations through AI\-powered applications, intelligent automation, and modern AI platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI solutions leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, SLMs, and RAG.
* Work closely with customers to understand business problems and translate them into scalable AI solutions.
* Develop AI\-powered applications for conversational AI, intelligent automation, and AI\-assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Build production\-ready AI workflows using LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini Enterprise, and similar AI platforms.
* Design agent orchestration frameworks integrating enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and external tools.
* Optimize AI solutions for accuracy, latency, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Build robust APIs, microservices, and AI services following software engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and DevOps teams to deliver enterprise AI platforms.
* Participate in customer workshops, solution design, PoCs, technical discussions, and deployment activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by evaluating emerging AI technologies and recommending innovative solutions.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 7–13 years of experience in Software Engineering, AI Engineering, or Machine Learning.

title: AI Platform Tech Lead
description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

*Lead how Sovos designs, operates, and scales AI across the business*
 Sovos is transforming how the world's businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, while simultaneously reinventing how we build software. Within the Office of the CTO, the Sovos Platform organization is growing our AI Platform team \- responsible for LLMOps foundation, tooling, and architectural patterns that let every engineering team at Sovos build and ship with AI responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 We're looking for an AI Tech Lead to guide that foundation from the inside. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering, architecture, and enablement \- leading the technical decisions that shape our LLMOps practice, guiding the engineers who build it, and acting as the connective tissue between the AI Platform team and every other team at Sovos learning to build with these tools. This is a highly visible role with a direct line to how AI gets used across the company.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
***Guiding LLMOps Strategy and Team Execution***
* You'll provide the technical leadership that keeps our LLMOps practice coherent as it scales \- guiding the AI Platform team's day\-to\-day decisions and making sure the practice holds together as new models, tools, and use cases arrive.
* Guide and support the AI Platform team on LLMOps decisions: model selection, evaluation strategy, prompt and context management, observability, and cost governance
* Set technical direction for how Sovos deploys, monitors, and continuously improves LLM\-based and agentic systems in production
* Establish standards and guardrails for prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI usage across teams
* Own the health of our LLMOps tooling and observability stack, and make the build\-vs\-buy calls as the landscape evolves


***Shaping Design and Architecture Decisions***
* You'll bring architectural rigor to how AI capabilities get built into the Sovos Platform, ensuring new AI features are designed to scale and integrate cleanly with Core Platform, Sovos Identity, and our broader compliance infrastructure.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to design AI\-enabled features and agentic services, from prototype through production
* Review and advise on technical designs across teams building on the AI Platform, flagging risk and identifying reuse opportunities early
* Help define the architectural patterns and reference implementations (skills, MCP tools, agent frameworks) other teams build from
* Balance rapid experimentation with the long\-term architectural integrity of the platform


***Partnering with Teams Across Sovos***
* Platform capabilities only create value once teams can actually use them. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for teams learning to adopt our LLMOps and AI toolsets, translating platform capability into practical, everyday workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams adopting AI coding assistants, agentic frameworks, and platform APIs
* Run workshops, office hours, and hands\-on sessions that teach teams how to use platform\-level LLM Ops and AI tooling effectively
* Translate platform capabilities into clear guidance, playbooks, and Skills that make the right way the easy way
* Communicate AI Platform direction and adoption progress to engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and the broader organization


***Leading and Growing the Team***
* You'll provide day\-to\-day guidance and technical leadership to the engineers building the AI Platform, raising the bar on quality while keeping the team moving fast.
* Guide and mentor AI Platform engineers, providing technical direction, code and design review, and career development
* Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, rigorous evaluation, and continuous learning
* Remove blockers so the team can ship reliable AI capabilities quickly
* Partner with the Chief Architect on team structure, hiring, and roadmap prioritization


**What We Need From You**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on time building and operating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems in production
* Deep familiarity with LLMOps practice: evaluation frameworks, observability and monitoring, prompt engineering, cost and performance optimization
* Experience guiding or leading engineers, whether as a formal manager, tech lead, or through mentorship and technical authority
* Strong architectural instincts \- comfortable making and defending design decisions that other teams will build on
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
* Technical depth across full\-stack development; familiarity with JavaScript/React and Java or .NET service\-oriented systems is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills \- able to explain AI platform concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of enabling other teams: through documentation, shared tooling, workshops, or hands\-on pairing


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience standing up or scaling an LLMOps practice from the ground up
* A genuine enthusiasm for teaching \- you'd rather show ten teams how to fish than build it for them once
* Comfort operating at the boundary of ambiguity, translating a fast\-moving AI landscape into concrete, adoptable guidance
* Experience balancing platform architecture rigor with the speed a hands\-on tech lead role demands


**What Sovos Offers You**
* Flexibility: 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with remote options for the rest.
* International exposure with a global organization.
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting\-Free Days.
* Mentoring programs and career development opportunities.
* Globally recognized training and development programs.
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage.
* A collaborative environment with modern tools and technologies.


**Our Recruitment Process**
* CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) \& EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
* Automated Video Interview
* Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or team
* Final Interview


**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance, and trust solutions, enabling businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with confidence. With more than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – Sovos processes over three billion transactions annually across 19,000 tax jurisdictions.
   

  

 Founded in 1979, Sovos operates across the Americas and Europe, backed by Hg and TA Associates. Learn more at sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
The role
 



 You will work across mobile, web, backend and cloud infrastructure. This is not a narrow ticket\-execution role: you will understand the user problem, shape requirements, make sound architectural decisions and ship complete features into production in close collaboration with the founder, product, design, AI/video and business teams.
 



 What you will own
 



 Product engineering
 


* Translate product ideas and business requirements into clear technical plans, milestones and production\-ready features.
* Own features end to end: discovery, technical design, implementation, testing, release, monitoring and iteration.
* Balance speed with maintainability, security, scalability and a high\-quality user experience.
* Contribute product judgment—not only code—by identifying edge cases, simplifying flows and recommending better solutions.



  





**FULL STACK DEVELOPER** 




  





**Mobile and web experiences** 



* Build and maintain the consumer mobile application in Flutter, including camera access, video capture and upload, challenge participation, profiles, rewards, notifications and leaderboards.
* Develop responsive web applications and dashboards using React/Next.js for enterprise users, administrators, creators and brand partners.
* Turn designs into polished, intuitive interfaces with strong attention to layout, motion, responsiveness, accessibility and consistency.
* Improve application performance across device types, browsers, network conditions and large media files.



  





**Backend, data and platform architecture** 



* Design and develop secure, well\-structured services and APIs using Node.js/TypeScript; experience with NestJS is preferred.
* Build data models and high\-performance workflows using PostgreSQL, an ORM such as Prisma, Redis and background job queues.
* Implement authentication, role\-based access, permissions, auditability, webhooks and third\-party integrations.
* Support real\-time and high\-engagement features such as scoring updates, leaderboards, notifications, moderation and campaign analytics.
* Design for multi\-tenant enterprise use, data isolation, reliability and increasing volumes of users, campaigns and video assets.



  





**AI and video workflows** 



* Integrate AI services for video scoring and analysis, avatar generation, voice, language, personalisation and content generation.
* Build resilient video ingestion, validation, storage, transcoding, rendering and delivery workflows using object storage, FFmpeg or related media services.
* Create asynchronous processing pipelines with queues, retries, progress states, fallbacks and cost\-aware API usage.
* Help improve trust and safety through moderation, fraud detection, duplicate or manipulated\-content checks and clear human\-review paths.



  










**Engineering quality and operations** 



* Set up and improve automated testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, error tracking, logging and production alerts.
* Deploy and operate services on a major cloud platform using containers and well\-managed environments.
* Diagnose production issues quickly and improve performance, resilience, security and developer efficiency over time.
* Maintain clear technical documentation and communicate progress, trade\-offs and risks to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  




* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience building and shipping full\-stack products.
* **Strong Flutter and Dart capability** 
 for production mobile applications.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Next.js, Node.js and modern API development.
* Solid experience with PostgreSQL, data modelling, caching, queues and performance optimisation.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs, SDKs, cloud storage and external services reliably.
* Comfort with Docker, Git, CI/CD and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* A strong grasp of application security, authentication, permissions, privacy and responsible handling of user and enterprise data.
* **Product\-management ability:** 
 you can break down ambiguous requirements, prioritise, estimate and drive work to completion.
* **Excellent communication skills:** 
 you can explain decisions clearly, surface risks early and collaborate constructively.
* **A strong aesthetic sense** 
 and genuine care for interaction quality, visual polish and the details users notice.
* High ownership, curiosity and comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can evolve quickly.



  





 Good to have:
 



  




* Experience with media\-heavy applications, video processing, streaming, transcoding or rendering pipelines.
* Experience with AI/ML APIs, multimodal models, recommendation or scoring systems, or human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation.
* Experience building gamification, social, creator, rewards, leaderboard or high\-concurrency consumer features.
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS, enterprise integrations, analytics dashboards and role\-based administration.
* Familiarity with WebSockets, event\-driven architecture, serverless services, content moderation or app\-store releases.



  





 How success will be measured
 


* Features move from concept to production with clear scope, sound engineering and predictable follow\-through.
* The mobile and web experiences feel fast, intuitive and visually refined.
* Video and AI workflows remain reliable despite large files, asynchronous processing and third\-party dependencies.
* The platforms become easier to operate, monitor, secure and scale with every release.
* Technical decisions and risks are documented and communicated before they become blockers.

description:
**About This Role**
**Business Unit Overview:**
 US Wealth Advisory (USWA) Business delivers BlackRock's full set of capabilities \- iShares, alpha\-seeking and alternative products, portfolio solutions and technology services \- to wealth management firms and financial advisors in the US.
   

  

 The Advisor Engagement group within the USWA Business delivers a broad set of services and client engagement approaches that amplify the work of our client teams. This includes digital client engagement, business consulting, thought leadership, advisor growth programs, and advisor education. The team also works closely with Global Marketing to design an integrated USWA marketing strategy. WEA (Wealth Enablement and Analytics) Engineering team within Advisor Engagement group is responsible for developing new tools and capabilities which enable Sales, Portfolio Consulting, and other Wealth Distribution partners to self\-service their advisor engagements, and drive innovation and scale.
   

  

**Job Purpose/Background**
 We are seeking an energetic professional to lead a team of Full Stack developers and have hands on technical experience in design and development of Python based Applications and Angular based Interactive Data Visualization solutions.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing the organization's Applied AI strategy by integrating AI\-powered capabilities into portfolio design platforms, engineering workflows, and business processes. The individual will identify opportunities where AI can create measurable business value, improve productivity, and enhance client and advisor experiences while ensuring responsibility and governed adoption of AI technologies.
   

  

 The individual must have a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and extensive experience building multi\-tier applications. The ideal candidate will thrive in a work environment that requires strong problem\-solving skills and independent self\-direction, coupled with an aptitude for team collaboration and open communication. Attention to detail and creativity in problem solving are critical skills.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team of Full Stack engineers, providing both technical leadership and people management while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives and complex programs, ensuring high\-quality execution, operational excellence, and timely delivery in partnership with business stakeholders and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Define and execute the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for portfolio design platforms and applications, leveraging enterprise capabilities and promoting scalable, reusable solutions that maximize business value.
* Champion Agile software development practices including planning, prioritization, backlog management, sprint execution, and continuous improvement to enhance team effectiveness and delivery outcomes.
* Establish and maintain engineering best practices across software development, production readiness, operational resilience, risk management, and platform governance.
* Lead the adoption of Applied AI technologies and AI\-assisted engineering practices to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and enhance business and client experiences.
* Identify, evaluate, and deliver AI\-enabled solutions, intelligent workflows, and automation opportunities that drive advisor engagement, operational efficiency, and measurable business impact.
* Partner closely with enterprise technology teams and business stakeholders to evaluate emerging technologies and translate innovative capabilities into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
* Promote responsible AI adoption by establishing best practices around governance, security, model evaluation, risk management, and compliance with enterprise standards.
* Serve as a strategic thought partner to business and technology leaders by challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities for innovation, and driving transformational initiatives that advance organizational objectives.
* Mentor and coach engineers and technical leaders, promoting AI literacy, technical excellence, and professional development across the organization.
* Adapt priorities and execution plans to meet evolving business needs while supporting firm\-wide initiatives and delivering high\-impact outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelors or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* 9–12 years of software engineering experience, preferably within the financial services industry, with at least 4 years leading high\-performing Full Stack development teams.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Python and modern web application development using frameworks such as Angular or React, with a solid understanding of APIs, HTTP, and REST\-based architecture.
* Proven experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise\-scale applications, including production infrastructure, deployment architectures, resiliency strategies, and business continuity planning.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and delivering AI\-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, or automation solutions that improve business outcomes and engineering productivity.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and enterprise AI architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Agentic AI solutions, including exposure to vector databases, semantic search, AI orchestration frameworks, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, governance frameworks, model risk management, and the practical application of AI to software engineering, analytics, advisor engagement, and workflow automation.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and business decisions by balancing risk, governance, operational considerations, and long\-term strategic objectives.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology organizations globally.
* Track record of delivering high\-impact solutions, building strong partnerships, and achieving high levels of business stakeholder satisfaction.
* Passion for technology and business innovation, with the ability to connect strategic objectives to technical execution and identify opportunities to drive scale and efficiency.
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and wealth management domain is strongly preferred.
* Flexibility to collaborate across global teams and support varying business and delivery schedules as needed.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: AI Full-Stack Developer
description:
What Sphere does
 
 We build automation for companies that still run on spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and an ERP nobody enjoys using. Workflow automation, AI agent systems, and ERP integrations for small and mid\-sized businesses across manufacturing, retail, D2C and services.
 



 We're a small team. That's the point: you'll hear about a client's problem on Monday and see something you built running inside their business by Friday.
 


 What you'd actually do
 
 You'll start inside Sphere rather than in front of clients. Internal tooling, lead generation pipelines, and the automations that run our own business, all built under guidance.
 



 Week one, realistically: an n8n pipeline that pulls prospect data from a few sources, enriches it, scores it, and drops a clean shortlist somewhere the team already works. Then you find out it breaks on half the inputs, and you fix that too.
 



 Client\-facing work during the internship is mostly maintenance. Keeping deployed systems running, and learning how they actually work end to end.
 



 At full\-time, the scope opens up. You'll write full backends and own client work directly.
 


 What we're looking for
 * You code with AI assistance and can tell when the output is wrong
* You're fast. A working first draft beats a perfect one that lands next week
* You're curious about industries that aren't tech, and how businesses actually run
* You want to be client\-facing eventually, even if you're not ready for it today


 Nice to have
 * Hands\-on with n8n, Make, or Zapier
* Things you've actually built and shipped. Side projects, freelance work, anything with real users
* Any exposure to ERPs, accounting systems, or business operations


 Who this isn't for
 * Someone who wants a well\-defined ticket queue and clear specs
* Someone who wants to train models and publish papers. This is applied engineering
* Someone who'd rather not talk to clients, ever


 How we hire
 1. Apply. The form takes ten minutes.
2. A short open\-ended project. A few hours. Deliberately under\-specified, because we want to see how you scope something, not whether you can follow instructions.
3. Two conversations. 15 to 60 minutes each, online or at our office. You'll walk through what you built and we'll talk about how you think.
4. Offer.


 Terms
 
 Six months, with the full\-time offer reviewed at month three. This is a hire\-track internship, not a temporary role.
 



 Mumbai hybrid is the preference. Fully remote is open for candidates who are clearly exceptional.
 



 Final\-year students and recent graduates are welcome. One to two years of experience is a plus, not a requirement.

description:

**Qualifications**

* Strong background designing enterprise scale, distributed systems, balancing functional requirements with non\-functional concerns such as resiliency, scalability, latency, and operability.


**Hand\-on experience with AI enabled SDLC / PDLC practices, including:**
* Using AI to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and architectural decision making
* Applying AI assisted development, testing, code review, and documentation practices
* Embedding AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services responsibly and securely
* Frameworks such as Windsurf \& Cursor and GitHub Copilot
* Ability to partner effectively with Product Management, Engineering, and Business leaders to translate strategic objectives into coherent architectural strategies.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to articulate complex architectural concepts to senior stakeholders and align diverse teams behind a shared technical vision.
* Track record at articulating architectural tradeoffs and design options, including impacts on scalability, resilience, cost, and delivery velocity.
* Strong architectural governance skills: setting standards, guiding design reviews, managing technical debt, and ensuring long term platform sustainability.
* Experience of API design principles \& Event Driven Architecture.
* Rigorous approach to quality through demonstrable TDD \& BDD experience.


**Nice To Have And Opportunities To Learn**
* Expertise in Domain Driven Design (DDD), including domain modelling and aligning architecture to complex business domains.
* Front office Portfolio Management or Wealth Management domain experience, with a strong understanding of investment workflows, decision making processes, and the role of technology in supporting portfolio managers and advisors.
* Domain knowledge of asset classes \& analytics (e.g., equities, fixed income, multi asset, alternatives) and how their characteristics influence risk, performance, liquidity, and system design.
* Experience with portfolio construction concepts, including asset allocation, constraints, benchmarks, rebalancing, and optimization, and how these map to scalable platform and architecture decisions.
* Exposure to event\-driven architectures at scale, including microservices, messaging, and streaming platforms aligned to business domains.
* Experience shaping or contributing to platform strategies that enable multiple product teams to move faster with consistency and autonomy.
* Familiarity with cloud native and hybrid architectures, including patterns for scalability, resilience, and cost aware design in large enterprises – including frameworks like Kubernetes.
* Exposure to modern DevOps and platform engineering practices that support high throughput, high quality delivery at enterprise scale, and demonstrable improvements across DORA metrics.
* Familiarity with micro frontend architectures, including their use in large scale, multi team environments to enable independent domain ownership, parallel delivery, and consistent user experiences across complex platform


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
